## Description

Combines continuous-time Neural ODEs with stochastic jump processes to model irregular tick-by-tick order arrival events and price jump dynamics.

## Where it may fit

Irregularly sampled tick data, high-frequency limit order book dynamics, flash liquidity shocks.

## Vehicles

High-Frequency Trading (HFT) Firms, Prop Trading Desks.

## Required data

Irregularly spaced tick execution logs and limit order book updates with high-resolution timestamps.

## Caveats

Numerical integration between jumps can be slow; requires specialized solvers like torchdiffeq.
